title: Notification fan-out
learning_objectives: Propose and revise an inspectable architecture
problem_statement: Notify recipients of an event without coupling user-facing latency to slow or unavailable delivery providers.

clarification_facts.delivery_semantics: at least once; suppress duplicate effects where supported

progressive_constraints.title: Accepted event
progressive_constraints.description: Persist pending work before accepting delivery responsibility.

progressive_constraints.title: Fan-out capacity
progressive_constraints.description: Compute recipients per second and compare with declared dispatch capacity.

progressive_constraints.title: Provider failure
progressive_constraints.description: A provider is unavailable for ten minutes; recover with bounded retries and an observable terminal state.

progressive_constraints.title: Preference change
progressive_constraints.description: A user unsubscribes after event acceptance but before sending. State the preference decision boundary.

valid_architecture_families.name: Fan-out on write
valid_architecture_families.description: Materialize recipient jobs with a durable outbox and bounded worker pool.

valid_architecture_families.name: Fan-out on read or grouped dispatch
valid_architecture_families.description: Retain events and derive recipients in batches at dispatch; preserve preference and retry identity.

common_misconceptions: One event can imply a million effects, not one queue task.
A successful enqueue is not a delivered notification.
A retry can violate user preferences unless the policy is explicit.

hint_ladder.level_1: Multiply event rate by recipients before picking worker count.
hint_ladder.level_2: Compare materialized per-recipient jobs with grouped batch derivation.
hint_ladder.level_3: 100 events/sec times 10000 recipients is 1M dispatches/sec before retries. A ten-minute outage creates backlog; retain delivery identity and define where current preferences are checked.

consolidation: Fan-out, delivery attempts, provider limits and preference validity must be modeled independently. Estimated dispatch capacity remains a declared assumption until benchmarked.
fresh_transfer_question: What changes if one event targets ten million recipients while normal events target ten?
coach_instructions: One clear question at a time. Inspect actual graph and stated assumptions. Do not grade prose by keywords or require a vendor name. Numeric assumptions are learner declarations, not measured performance. Explain when asked, require teach-back, and preserve alternative valid designs. Do not silently edit the diagram.
